description: This file contains functions for exporting scenes to canvas and SVG formats, including handling of scene elements, background, clip paths, font inlining, and payload encoding/decoding for scene serialization.

methods.name: truncateText
methods.description: Truncates text in a text element to fit within a maximum width, appending ellipsis if necessary.

methods.name: addFrameLabelsAsTextElements
methods.description: Adds text elements as labels for frame-like elements for export purposes.

methods.name: getFrameRenderingConfig
methods.description: Determines the frame rendering configuration based on the exporting frame and current app state.

methods.name: prepareElementsForRender
methods.description: Prepares scene elements for rendering, including handling overlapping frames and frame labels.

methods.name: exportToCanvas
methods.description: Exports scene elements to a Canvas element, handling scaling, background, and image caching.

methods.name: createHTMLComment
methods.description: Creates an HTML comment node with specified text.

methods.name: exportToSvg
methods.description: Exports scene elements to an SVG element, including scene serialization, clip paths, font inlining, and background rendering.

methods.name: encodeSvgBase64Payload
methods.description: Encodes scene payload into base64 and embeds it into SVG metadata comments.

methods.name: decodeSvgBase64Payload
methods.description: Decodes scene payload from embedded base64 data in SVG.

methods.name: getCanvasSize
methods.description: Calculates the minimal bounding box size to fit all scene elements with padding.

methods.name: getExportSize
methods.description: Calculates the export size in pixels based on scene elements, padding, and scale.
